items.stem: The sequence of dependent tasks that determines the shortest project duration is the:

options.rationale: Correct: the critical path is the longest dependent chain setting the minimum duration.
Float is slack on non-critical tasks, not the path itself.
Milestones mark events; they are not the dependent chain.
The WBS decomposes scope; it does not by itself set duration.

items.explanation: Correct: the critical path is the longest dependent chain setting the minimum duration.

items.stem: Quality control (QC) in a project most directly refers to:

options.text: Preventing errors by setting up good processes
options.rationale: That describes quality assurance (QA), which is process-focused.

options.text: Checking deliverables to detect and correct defects
options.rationale: Correct: QC inspects outputs to find and fix defects.
Fee negotiation is a business, not QC, activity.

items.explanation: Correct: QC inspects outputs to find and fix defects.

items.stem: Which TWO belong in a project work plan?

options.rationale: Correct: milestones and deadlines are core to a work plan.

options.text: Staffing aligned to the fee budget
options.rationale: Correct: resourcing against the fee budget belongs in the work plan.
Irrelevant personal content is not part of a work plan.
Another firm's finances are irrelevant to this project plan.
